data.text: I’m willing to take 6 tons this month so John and Kate can each take 12, with Jack and Emma taking 10 each. That totals 50 tons, leaving 50 to double back to 100. Earnings would be $6,000 for me, $12,000 each for John and Kate, and $10,000 each for Jack and Emma. I’ll keep my own catch to 6 tons this month; everyone else’s share is a proposal, not an assumption. We can discuss rotating the smaller share in future months if people are interested. John, would you be willing to choose 12 tons under this plan? I’d like to hear from everyone before calling it an agreement.
